title: Clerk.io - Integration issues with major platforms reported
clean_text: At least one verified reviewer describes the Clerk.io integration with Magento 2 as deeply problematic. The platform's per-feature pricing model, while modular, means customization options outside the predefined feature set can be limited, requiring users to choose between multiple separately priced modules rather than a single all-inclusive plan. No free trial is offered on some plan structures, requiring direct quote requests for accurate pricing.
